description: Set up a custom domain for real internet email via Cloudflare (requires master API key). ADVANCED: Requires Cloudflare account, API token, and a domain. Emails send from agent@yourdomain.com with full DKIM/SPF/DMARC. Optionally configures Gmail SMTP as outbound relay (recommended for residential IPs). After setup with gmailRelay, use setup_gmail_alias for each agent.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

cloudflareToken.description: Cloudflare API token (Zone>Zone>Read, Zone>DNS>Edit, Zone>Email Routing Rules>Edit, Account>Cloudflare Tunnel>Edit, Account>Workers Scripts>Edit; optional: Account>Registrar: Domains>Edit for domain purchase)

gmailRelay.description: Gmail SMTP relay for outbound delivery (recommended for residential IPs without PTR records)

email.description: Gmail address for SMTP relay (e.g., you@gmail.com)

purchase.description: Purchase a new domain (if domain not provided)

keywords.description: Keywords to search for available domains

name: setup_email_domain
